integrity.claim_scope: All real \(\gamma>0\), \(q\in[0,1]\), and disk pairs; normalized area \(dA/\pi\).
integrity.evidence: Exact moment calculation, analytic integral-disk certificate, Cayley endpoint argument; companion finite tests do not establish universal quantifiers

limitations: Only the disk weight \(1-q|z|^{2\gamma}\) with \(\gamma>0\) and real \(q\in[0,1]\).
Does not classify general decreasing, smooth, radial or multi-power weights.
Literature search may miss unindexed equivalent statements; independent audit was not performed.
title: Zero-free power-deficit radial Bergman kernels
